title: Governments
source: project.json CGovernment::LoadKey (0x124660) and BiceLib GameClasses/CGovernment.hpp: `duration`, `valid_for_new_country`, `election`, then the ideology database, then the government position database, then CModifier::LoadKey

file.desc: each key is a government (loader 0x525470, not read)

government.desc: a government: three keys, then ideologies and positions by name, then falls through to CModifier::LoadKey for any other key - a modifier kind; which names that takes is not read, so an unknown one is reported softly

duration.desc: months between elections (atoi of the value)

valid_for_new_country.desc: whether a released country may take it; defaults to yes

election.desc: whether it holds elections; defaults to no

patterns.desc: `yes` makes the ideology acceptable to this government
